name: fireworks-engine
description: Reusable canvas fireworks runtime package for standalone integrations and demos.
author: coinexplain

scripts.smoke: node --check src/index.js && node --input-type=module -e "const mod = await import('./src/index.js'); if (typeof mod.createFireworksEngine !== 'function' || typeof mod.resolveFireworksEnginePreset !== 'function' || typeof mod.default !== 'function') throw new Error('package smoke failed'); console.log('package smoke ok');"
scripts.test: npm run smoke && npm run typecheck
